boundary_classes.absence_reason: The console runs inside a browser sandbox and spawns no child process of its own.
This case exercises only the UI runtime boundary's provisional re-probe discharge.
A single page client has no server middleware and no raw buffer handling of its own.
The client keeps no local database and persists nothing between sessions.
Every query is a synchronous request and no queue or broker carries work for it.
The target is a desktop browser with no sensor, serial or bluetooth peripheral.
Embedding and scoring happen behind the search service and are opaque to the client.
The suite drives the real component tree, so no substitute stands in for a boundary.
Probing met no boundary outside the nine classes the register already names.
